title: Administrative Governance Controls
description: Defines role-based governance controls for the future Admin Portal. Prepares the May Admin Portal governance controls: role definitions, approval boundaries, and access control matrix.

roles.description: Manages question content — authorized to write, edit, and archive questions. Cannot certify or change governance rules.
roles.approvalBoundary: May modify content only. All certification actions require CERTIFICATION_REVIEWER. All governance rule changes require GOVERNANCE_ADMIN.

roles.description: Reviews and certifies questions — authorized to transition question_state to Certified after CAQS §1.6 verification.
roles.approvalBoundary: May transition question_state across all states. Cannot modify CorrectChoice — that requires CONTENT_ADMIN. Must document HIGH-confidence verification per CAQS §1.6.

roles.description: Oversees governance enforcement — authorized to create/close governance events, approve waivers, and escalate critical findings.
roles.approvalBoundary: May manage governance events and approve waivers. Cannot modify content, answer keys, or governance rules. All rule changes require SYSTEM_ADMIN.

roles.description: Full platform authority — can modify governance rules, deployment configuration, and role definitions. Approves governance rule changes.
roles.approvalBoundary: Full authority. Cannot modify content or answer keys — that requires CONTENT_ADMIN. Cannot certify — that requires CERTIFICATION_REVIEWER.

separationOfDuties.rule: No single role may both modify answer keys and certify. No role that certifies may also approve governance waivers on the same QID.

conflicts.conflict: Cannot approve waivers on QIDs they certified within 30 days

futureEnhancements: Admin Portal UI with role-based dashboard views
Approval workflow engine: submit → review → approve → deploy
Audit log of all role actions (immutable append-only)
